taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-08 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 218.1 | 18.02 | 18.02
2 | 105.0 | 1.05 | 19.07
3 | 60.0 | 1.04 | 20.11
4 | 317.3 | 0.57 | 20.68
5 | 1743.2 | 5.17 | 25.85
6 | 2231.3 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-08
Curve type: QHA-type (initial descending Q–H trend to a low-resistivity minimum at layer 3, followed by a progressive ascending A trend into the resistive basement)
Aquifer depth: 20.68 – 25.85 m (Layer 5, the moderately resistive fractured/weathered zone overlying the fresh basement)

Recommendation: Case and grout the borehole through the shallow low-resistivity clay/silt zone (≈19.1–20.1 m) to prevent inflow of fines, then screen the interval 20.68–25.85 m, which represents the fractured/weathered basement aquifer. Drilling can be terminated a short distance into the underlying high-resistivity fresh basement (>25.85 m, 2231 ohm-m) once confirmed, as it is expected to be largely impermeable.
